normalization: Decode each source as UTF-8 accepting and removing an initial BOM; replace CRLF and lone CR with LF; encode UTF-8 without BOM. Preserve every other character, indentation, whitespace and terminal newline. Selector slices include complete ast.FunctionDef lineno..end_lineno physical lines, including each rationale docstring and original terminal newline. Full shared-file and code hashes use the same normalization.
review_invalidation: Any selector, code-under-test or shared-source canonical hash change makes this recorded disposition unreviewed until a new independent review. Current rows certify only the named 14 selectors, not the repository test inventory. Historical rows and original controls retain their original source provenance.
